page_title: Open canvas where ideas become visuals. beta

sources.entry: Shortodella - AI graphics platform with a canvas editor for image generation, video creation, chat-based editing, and background removal. Free tier available.

summary.name: Shortodella
summary.one_liner: Shortodella is a beta AI graphics platform where you create images and short videos and edit them on a visual canvas through a chat-style conversation with an AI agent.
use_cases: turn a photo into a short video
edit and compose images on a canvas
summary.what_it_does: Shortodella lets users generate images and videos from text prompts and edit or compose them on a visual canvas, driven by a conversational AI agent. Video generation produces 1 to 8 second clips up to 1080p, either from text or from photos. Image generation covers a range of styles and sizes, from photorealistic product shots to illustrations. The AI agent takes plain-English descriptions and handles generating, editing, and arranging elements. The page says it is powered by Nanobanana, Kling, Grok, and Veo. Pricing tiers list a free plan plus paid monthly plans that add a media gallery, canvas AI editor, interface tools, and MCP tools.
notable: Visual canvas editor combined with a chat-style AI agent
Video generation of 1 to 8 seconds up to 1080p from text or photos
Built on third-party models: Nanobanana, Kling, Grok, and Veo
MCP tools included in paid plans
caveats: Free tier requires attribution and only includes basic image collections
Paid plans start at $9/mo; extra energy packs cost $49 one-time for 390 energy valid 3 months
AI tools consume a monthly energy allowance
